title: Carbon gets a price
body: Regulators now charge €100 for every tonne of CO2 your plants emit. Cheap fossil power just got a second bill.

choices.label: Pay it
choices.outcome: Every tonne now shows up on your P&L.

choices.label: Lobby for an exemption
choices.hint: −€250k now, no tax for 2 years. People will notice.
choices.outcome: Exemption granted for two years. A journalist published your lobbying bill.

delayed.message: Your lobbied exemption expired. Carbon tax applies now.

choices.label: Publish a fossil phase-out plan
choices.hint: The tax applies; your plan earns trust.
choices.outcome: Every tonne now costs money, and you have a plan to emit fewer of them.

source: EU ETS carbon prices have hovered around €60-100/t in recent years; €100 is a round game value

title: Environmental permit audit
body: Inspectors want your energy, water and waste figures for the last three years.

choices.label: Hand over your measured data
choices.outcome: Audit closed in a day. Measuring paid off.

choices.label: Pay the fine for missing records
choices.outcome: €600k fine. Lesson noted.

choices.label: Send rough estimates and hope
choices.outcome: They accepted it, for now.

title: Building permit freeze
body: Noise, traffic, land: the region is saturated. No new client growth here for two years.

choices.label: Accept the cap
choices.outcome: Growth frozen for 2 years.

choices.label: Lobby the mayor to lift it
choices.outcome: The freeze is lifted for you. Neighbours are furious.

choices.label: Open your campus to the town
choices.hint: Share heat, jobs and data; growth paused.
choices.outcome: Growth pauses, but the town starts to see you as a neighbour.

source: Grid connection queues and moratoria on new datacenter connections have occurred in several regions (e.g. around Dublin and Amsterdam); details are game design

title: Locals march against you
body: Noise, water, land, power bills: the town has had enough of your expansion plans.

choices.label: Fund local projects and publish your impact
choices.outcome: Tensions ease. Transparency costs less than conflict.

choices.label: Offer free heat to the swimming pool and school
choices.outcome: Warm pool, warm feelings.

choices.label: Ignore them
choices.outcome: The council blocks your next building permit.

title: Your footprint goes viral
body: An investigation names you the region's dirtiest datacenter. Clients don't want their logo next to yours.

choices.label: Apologise and publish a real plan
choices.outcome: Painful, but clients respect the honesty.

choices.label: Deny everything
choices.outcome: The story fades, for now.

delayed.message: Leaked documents revive the scandal. More clients leave.

title: Drought: water capped
body: Reservoirs are low. Authorities cap industrial water withdrawals, and your cooling towers are the biggest straw in town.

choices.label: Throttle cooling and capacity
choices.outcome: You shed clients and run hot until the rains come.

choices.label: Truck in water from elsewhere
choices.outcome: The trucks are photographed. It does not look good.

choices.label: Switch to closed-loop water now
choices.outcome: Expensive in a rush, but you stop competing with farms for water.

source: Water stress and datacenter siting conflicts have been reported in several dry regions; numbers are game design

title: Greenwashing exposed
body: An NGO shows your 'carbon neutral' badge rests on cheap, unverifiable offsets. You had no data to back it up.

choices.label: Drop the badge, publish real numbers
choices.outcome: You lose the green premium and some clients, but keep your credibility.

choices.label: Double down: 'our offsets are certified'
choices.outcome: The story runs for a week. Clients leave.

source: Directive (EU) 2024/825 restricts generic environmental claims and offset-based neutrality claims

title: The AI hype cools down
body: Half the startups renting your GPUs ran out of funding. The cluster sits half empty.

choices.label: Absorb the loss
choices.outcome: A quarter of your load vanished overnight.

choices.label: Rent the GPUs to researchers at cost
choices.outcome: Climate and health labs move in. Lower margins, useful work.

title: Rebound: efficiency made you cheap
body: Your efficiency gains let you cut prices. Demand is surging. More clients, more servers, more total energy.

choices.label: Ride the wave: +40 % clients
choices.outcome: Revenue jumps. So does your total footprint.

choices.label: Grow a little, keep prices up
choices.outcome: Some growth, better margins, a bit more footprint.

choices.label: Cap growth, bank the savings
choices.outcome: Your efficiency gains actually reduce your impact.

source: Rebound effect (Jevons paradox), cited in AFNOR Spec 2314

title: New EU reporting duty
body: Datacenters above 500 kW must now report their energy, water and renewable figures every year.

choices.label: Send your measured data
choices.outcome: Done in an afternoon.

choices.label: Hire consultants to estimate it
choices.outcome: €200k for a spreadsheet. Next year too.

choices.label: Fudge the numbers
choices.outcome: Nobody checks. Yet.

source: Energy Efficiency Directive (EU) 2023/1791, Art. 12, and Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1364 (reporting for datacenters with ≥500 kW IT power)

title: Heatwave
body: 42 °C outside. Your chillers are screaming and the grid is stressed.

choices.label: Pause non-urgent jobs
choices.outcome: Batch jobs wait a few days. Nobody notices.

choices.label: Max out the chillers
choices.outcome: Expensive energy, but everything runs.

choices.label: Spray water on the coolers
choices.outcome: Cheap and effective. The town's water tower disagrees.

title: Cascade failure
body: One overheated rack takes down its neighbours. Clients are on the phone.

choices.label: Emergency repairs
choices.outcome: Fixed. Expensive.

choices.label: Run degraded for a while
choices.outcome: Some clients leave for a competitor.

title: A 'free' recycling offer
body: A broker offers to take your old servers for free, and even pay you. They will be 'recycled' abroad.

choices.label: Take the money

delayed.message: Investigators traced your servers to an illegal dump overseas.

choices.outcome: +€150k. Out of sight, out of mind.

choices.label: Pay a certified recycler
choices.outcome: Metals recovered, toxics handled properly.

source: Global E-waste Monitor 2024 (UNITAR/ITU) documents large undocumented and transboundary e-waste flows

title: Investors want 2x growth
body: Your board says competitors are doubling every year. They want the same, or they pull funding.

choices.label: Promise hypergrowth
choices.outcome: +€500k funding, and a growth target to hit.

choices.label: Grow, with efficiency conditions
choices.outcome: +€300k, moderate targets.

choices.label: Pitch steady, efficient growth
choices.outcome: No new money, but no pressure either.

title: GPU shortage
body: New accelerators are sold out for a year. Prices have tripled on the open market.

choices.label: Pay whatever it takes
choices.outcome: You got your chips. Your wallet is lighter.

choices.label: Make the current fleet last
choices.outcome: More maintenance, fewer new chips.

choices.label: Buy on the grey market
choices.outcome: Cheap chips of unknown origin.

title: Fuel prices jump
body: Gas, coal and wood prices jump 40 % for two years. Your fuel bill follows.

choices.label: Pay the higher price
choices.outcome: Fuel costs 40 % more for two years.

choices.label: Switch to cheaper, dirtier fuel
choices.outcome: The bill barely moves. The air gets worse.

choices.label: Lock a long-term fuel contract
choices.outcome: You pay upfront and your fuel price stays put.
